key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks
AUD smashed on growth scare; oil 'exploded' as price suppression failed, fuel prices set to rise 30c
Iron ore entering 'bloodletting' phase; gold underperforming ('schmould')
RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern; housing prices crashing with first-home buyer surge
ANZ announced 3,500 job cuts; mining sector seeing cap-raise dash for cash
Santos preservation described as national sacrifice; energy security under strain
Woolworths breached 'Price Freeze' on four staples, reigniting cost-of-living debate
Airlines under pressure: one flight cancelled every three days due to staff shortages plus oil spike

sectors.trend: Sharp deterioration. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; gold underperforming. Kalgoorlie Super Pit fire (WorkSafe investigation) adds operational risk. Small-caps (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) showing relative strength but sector-wide cap raises signal cash stress.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from falling iron ore. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) lack safe-haven bid. Cap-raise dilution risk elevated for juniors.

sectors.trend: Banks tumbling on rising bond yields and rate-rise fears. ANZ cutting 3,500 jobs signals cost discipline but also demand softness. RBA rental-inflation focus may delay rate cuts, compressing NIMs.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX under pressure from yield curve steepening and credit-risk concerns. ANZ restructuring may support medium-term EPS but near-term sentiment negative.

sectors.trend: Oil 'exploded' as suppression failed; fuel prices rising 30c. Santos preservation described as national sacrifice, implying policy support but capital inefficiency. LNG and coal exposed to global oil complex.
sectors.implications: SOL.AX, WDS.AX, BOQ.AX benefit from oil spike but face policy overhang. Coal (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) supported by energy security narrative.

sectors.trend: Woolworths breached Price Freeze on staples; housing crash driving first-home buyer surge but no auction rebound. Budget-conscious shopping trend (Walmart/Target parallel) pressures WES margins.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOL.AX face margin compression from input costs vs. pricing power limits. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by rental inflation but occupancy concerns.

sectors.trend: Oil spike plus chronic staff shortages (1 in 3 flights cancelled) squeezing Qantas and Virgin margins. Delta parallel shows premium pricing power as offset.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX, DLO.AX face dual headwind of fuel costs and capacity constraints. Premium segments may cushion but overall sector negative.

sectors.trend: Bird flu in sea lions (SA) a minor biosecurity flag. AI development slowdown calls from tech execs create uncertainty. Superannuation reform debate (10 reasons 'not fit for purpose') could reshape fund flows.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX relatively insulated. Super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPT.AX) face policy risk. Tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX) mixed on AI narrative.

key_themes: Oil price surge driving inflation re-acceleration fears and rate-cut delay
AUD weakness amplifying import costs and commodity export revenue
Iron ore structural downcycle pressuring ASX 200 earnings
Housing correction creating first-home buyer opportunity but no demand rebound
Mining sector liquidity stress via cap raises
Cost-of-living pressure on consumer staples pricing power
Superannuation policy debate as potential structural market catalyst

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike triggering inflation re-acceleration and RBA rate-cut delay
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour rate-sensitive defensives; monitor RBA statements for guidance

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price deterioration compressing ASX 200 earnings (BHP, RIO, FMG)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce materials weight; diversify into gold, energy, and healthcare

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD weakness amplifying import inflation and corporate input costs
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour export-oriented and domestic-revenue companies; avoid import-heavy retailers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mining sector cap-raise dilution and liquidity stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid junior miners with weak balance sheets; focus on cash-generative majors

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction spilling into credit losses for banks
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor NIM and credit-cost guidance; favour banks with strong capital buffers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Airlines capacity constraints and fuel cost squeeze
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid QAN.AX, DLO.AX near-term; wait for fuel stabilisation

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy producers benefiting from oil spike
opportunities.rationale: Oil 'exploded' as suppression failed; SOL.AX and WDS.AX gain from higher realised prices and energy security policy support

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive healthcare and consumer staples with pricing power
opportunities.rationale: CSL.AX insulated from commodity cycle; WES.AX benefits from budget-shopper trend despite margin pressure

opportunities.recommendation: Selective first-home buyer REIT exposure on housing correction
opportunities.rationale: Housing crash driving buyer surge; social rental build (Perth) signals policy support for affordable housing

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce materials/mining allocation; hedge iron ore exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; ASX shed $90bn on miner/bank selloff; cap-raise dilution risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim airline and transport exposure pending fuel stabilisation
defensive_moves.rationale: Oil spike plus 1-in-3 flight cancellations create dual margin headwind

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash or short-duration bonds as rate-cut timeline extends
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA rental-inflation focus delays easing; bond yields rising; AUD weakness adds FX risk

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to consolidate lower as oil-driven inflation fears delay RBA easing. Miners and banks remain under pressure. AUD weakness supports exporters but hurts importers. Expect volatility around RBA commentary and oil prints.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction may stabilise within 6–12 months, supporting first-home buyer demand. Energy security policy supports Santos/LNG. Superannuation reform debate could unlock structural fund-flow shifts. Iron ore downcycle may bottom by H2 2027.
key_catalysts: RBA statement on rental inflation and rate path
Iron ore price trajectory (BHP/RIO/FMG earnings impact)
ANZ restructuring progress and cost-out outcomes
Housing auction data and first-home buyer pipeline
watch_list: Brent crude and Australian fuel prices
RBA cash rate and forward guidance
QAN.AX/DLO.AX capacity and fuel cost metrics
